component.name: Next GDrive
component.summary: Sync or stream your Google Drive

description.p: Next GDrive keeps your Google Drive on your computer, for one or more Google accounts, with My Drive and shared drives.
Each account works in one of two modes:

ul.li: Mirror: the folders you choose are copied to your computer and kept in sync in both directions.
Stream: the whole Drive appears in a folder and files are downloaded only when you open them. Files and folders can be kept available offline.

description.p: Nothing is deleted permanently: deleted files go to the Google Drive trash, which you can browse and restore from. When a file changes in two places, both versions are kept.
The app runs in the background with a tray icon and notifications, and everything it does is also available from the command line.
